name: Quince
siboNotes: Quince is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's low FODMAP and typically consumed cooked, which aids digestion.
preparationTips: Always cook quince before eating as raw fruit is very tart and astringent
Peel and core before cooking to remove tough skin and seeds
Poach in low-FODMAP sweetener or roast until tender
Cooking transforms the flesh from white to pink/red color
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
